name: Gitea Runner
description: Gitea Runner (act_runner) is the daemon that executes CI/CD jobs for Gitea Actions. It connects to your Gitea instance, polls for queued workflow runs, and executes tasks using either host execution or containerized engines.

app_vars.name: var_gitea_url
app_vars.label: Gitea Instance URL
app_vars.help: URL of your Gitea instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:3000 or https://gitea.example.com)

app_vars.name: var_gitea_token
app_vars.label: Registration Token
app_vars.help: Runner registration token from Gitea (Site Administration > Actions > Runners or Repo/Org Settings > Actions > Runners)

notes.text: Create a registration token in Gitea under Site Administration > Actions > Runners and enter it with your Gitea URL during setup, so the runner registers and starts on its own.
Skipped that step? Run the register command the install prints, then start the gitea-runner service.
